title: piebird settings: ~/.agents/piebird/settings.json, <project>/.agents/piebird/settings.json
description: Settings for the piebird plugins, a section per plugin. The project's file applies to everyone in the repo; yours, in your home folder, wins over it; an agent's own settings screen wins over both. Never secrets.

search.title: Search with Kagi
search.description: How much your agent relies on Kagi when it searches the web.

oneOf.title: Kagi only
oneOf.description: Every web search goes through Kagi. The agent's own web search is refused, even when Kagi fails, and the agent is told not to use other search tools.

oneOf.title: Kagi first
oneOf.description: The agent searches with Kagi. Its own web search stays out of the way until a Kagi search fails in the conversation; other search tools are for when Kagi fails or when you ask for one.

oneOf.title: Kagi offered
oneOf.description: Kagi is one more way to search. Nothing is refused or hidden, and the agent picks.

folder.title: Threads folder
folder.description: The folder of the project's open threads, one .md file each: relative to the project, or absolute. Empty: the folder the project's .omp/threads.json names, if any.
